name: GS Caltex Yeosu SOLEX burner retrofit
description: Refinery fired-heater retrofit using 32 John Zink SOLEX burners, achieving below 5 ppm NOx and avoiding an SCR; the case study quotes about USD 150,000 per year in avoided operating cost without a dollar year.
notes: The cost figure is left in the description with its missing dollar year stated; no capex record is asserted.
